shields_note: Posted inside the Starting section, each marked '-DS': Aim High, Don't Do That Again, Another Pathetic Lifeform, A Close Race, He Can Go About His Business, Your Ship? and Let's Keep A Little Optimism Here; listed as Defensive Shields outside the deck.
notes: Posted 27 November 2001, before Theed Palace, so the format is Premiere - Reflections III; every card is from Reflections III or earlier (the Theed Palace Generator sites are the Reflections III printings).

Starting cards as posted under Starting: We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates, Naboo: Theed Palace Generator Core, Naboo: Theed Palace Generator, Inner Strength, Heading For The Medical Frigate, Your Insight Serves You Well, Sando Aqua Monster and An Unusual Amount Of Fear; these count toward the total.

The seven '-DS' cards in the starting section are taken as Defensive Shields (outside the deck): Aim High, Don't Do That Again, Another Pathetic Lifeform and Let's Keep A Little Optimism Here dested the Reflections III Defensive Shield printings, not the Effects of the same names.
The author's update says Luke's Lightsaber (DSII) should be x2; listed as 2.

Posted 'Qui-Gon's Lightsaber (R3)' dested the Reflections III Qui-Gon's Lightsaber; 'Obi-Wan's Lightsaber (R3)' the Reflections III Obi-Wan's Lightsaber; 'Obi-Wan's Lightsaber (Premiere)' the Premiere Obi-Wan's Lightsaber; 'Your Insight serves You Well' (posted without Staging Areas) the Death Star II Effect.
The 'Lightsabers' section header was not a card and is dropped.
The list totals 57 as published (with the update's second Luke's Lightsaber), plus 7 shields; kept as posted.
Byline 'Darth Vader "The Dark" Lord of The Sith' is a character name, so the deck is credited to the handle The Dark with no player page.
